speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome. I am Dr. Agent, and I will be examining you today. Please tell me, have you noticed any blue tint to your skin, especially around the lips or face? This helps me determine if you are experiencing cyanosis.

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, female. The patient is a 3000-g (6.6-lb) female newborn delivered at term to a 23-year-old primigravida mother. The mother reports having had no prenatal care, and immunization records for the newborn are not available.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the details. Since you are a newborn, I cannot ask you questions directly, but I need to know if you are currently feeding well and if you have noticed any jaundice (yellowing of the skin or eyes). REQUEST TEST: Complete_Blood_Count, Bilirubin_Level, Blood_Type.

speaker: Doctor
text: Since the CBC and bilirubin are normal and there is no cyanosis, I need to check your heart rate and rhythm for any murmurs, and ask if the baby has been crying excessively or feeding poorly. REQUEST TEST: ECG, Chest_XRay. DIAGNOSIS READY: Normal Newborn
